column4: cyweb - Cybrium Web Vulnerability Scanner | Fast Rust web vulnerability scanner with SARIF output | Fast web vulnerability scanner built in Rust. Scans headers, paths, server configurations, and known vulnerabilities using YAML rules, with CVE detection, baseline diffing, and SARIF output for CI/CD integration.

cymail - Cybrium Email Security Scanner | SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS and BIMI posture scoring | Email security scanner that evaluates SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE and BIMI for a domain, scores the posture, and reports concrete remediation steps.

cyguard - Cybrium Endpoint Security Agent | Lightweight endpoint agent for process, network and software inventory | Lightweight endpoint security agent that collects process, network connection, and installed software inventory for posture assessment and reporting.

cyprobe - Cybrium OT/SCADA Discovery Probe | Passive and active industrial device fingerprinting | OT/SCADA network discovery and posture probe. Performs passive and active fingerprinting of industrial devices and reports protocol exposure and configuration weaknesses.

cysense - Cybrium Passive Network Sensor | Traffic capture, protocol dissection and asset discovery | Passive network sensor for IT, OT and IoMT environments. Captures traffic, dissects protocols, and discovers assets without sending packets to the monitored network.

cywave - Cybrium Wireless RF Sensor | Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, LoRaWAN and drone detection | Wireless RF sensor that detects and inventories Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy, Zigbee, LoRaWAN and drone signals for wireless attack surface monitoring.

cydeep - Cybrium PLC Deep Inspection | Purdue Level 0 visibility for S7, CIP, Modbus and BACnet | PLC and field asset deep inspection tool providing Purdue Level 0 visibility. Reads device identity and configuration over S7, CIP, Modbus and BACnet for inventory and posture assessment.
